model.title: Recognizing the Role of Direct Support Professionals Act
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee · Sen. Maggie Hassan (D-NH)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Office of Management and Budget to review whether the Standard Occupational Classification system—the federal government's tool for categorizing job types—should create a separate classification code specifically for direct support professionals, who provide essential care and assistance to people with disabilities and other support needs.
